passages.text: Then Joseph instructed his steward: “Fill the men’s sacks with as much food as they can carry, and put each one’s silver in the mouth of his sack.
passages.sermon:
Joseph was the ruler in Egypt.
Joseph had a steward who managed his house.
Joseph gave his steward a command.
Joseph said, "Fill the men's sacks with food."
Joseph said, "Give them as much food as they can carry."
Joseph said, "Put each man's silver in the mouth of his sack."
passages.original: וַיְצַ֞ו אֶת־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־ בֵּיתוֹ֮ לֵאמֹר֒ מַלֵּ֞א אֶת־ אַמְתְּחֹ֤ת הָֽאֲנָשִׁים֙ אֹ֔כֶל כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר יוּכְל֖וּן שְׂאֵ֑ת וְשִׂ֥ים כֶּֽסֶף־ אִ֖ישׁ בְּפִ֥י אַמְתַּחְתּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Put my cup, the silver one, in the mouth of the youngest one’s sack, along with the silver for his grain.” So the steward did as Joseph had instructed.
passages.sermon:
Joseph was the ruler in Egypt.
Joseph spoke to his steward.
Joseph gave a command.
Joseph said, "Take my cup."
The cup was made of silver.
Put the silver cup in the mouth of the youngest brother’s sack.
Also put the silver for his grain in the same sack.
The steward listened to Joseph.
The steward did what Joseph said.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ גְּבִיעִ֞י גְּבִ֣יעַ הַכֶּ֗סֶף תָּשִׂים֙ בְּפִי֙ אַמְתַּ֣חַת הַקָּטֹ֔ן וְאֵ֖ת כֶּ֣סֶף שִׁבְר֑וֹ וַיַּ֕עַשׂ כִּדְבַ֥ר יוֹסֵ֖ף אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֵּֽר׃

passages.text: At daybreak, the men were sent on their way with their donkeys.
passages.sermon:
It was morning.
The sun had risen.
Joseph’s brothers were ready to leave.
Joseph’s brothers were sent away.
They took their donkeys with them.
passages.original: הַבֹּ֖קֶר א֑וֹר וְהָאֲנָשִׁ֣ים שֻׁלְּח֔וּ הֵ֖מָּה וַחֲמֹרֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: They had not gone far from the city when Joseph told his steward, “Pursue the men at once, and when you overtake them, ask, ‘Why have you repaid good with evil?
passages.sermon:
Joseph was the governor of Egypt.
Joseph had a steward who managed his house.
The men left the city.
They did not go far.
Joseph spoke to his steward.
Joseph said, "Get up."
"Chase after the men."
"Catch up to them."
"When you reach them, speak to them."
"Ask them, 'Why did you repay good with evil?'"
passages.original: הֵ֠ם יָֽצְא֣וּ אֶת־ הָעִיר֮ לֹ֣א הִרְחִיקוּ֒ וְיוֹסֵ֤ף אָמַר֙ לַֽאֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־ בֵּית֔וֹ ק֥וּם רְדֹ֖ף אַחֲרֵ֣י הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֑ים וְהִשַּׂגְתָּם֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם לָ֛מָּה שִׁלַּמְתֶּ֥ם רָעָ֖ה תַּ֥חַת טוֹבָֽה׃

passages.text: Is this not the cup my master drinks from and uses for divination? What you have done is wicked!’ ”
passages.sermon:
Joseph was the master of the house.
Joseph drank from this cup.
Joseph used this cup for divination.
You took this cup.
You did something evil.
passages.original: הֲל֣וֹא זֶ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁתֶּ֤ה אֲדֹנִי֙ בּ֔וֹ וְה֕וּא נַחֵ֥שׁ יְנַחֵ֖שׁ בּ֑וֹ הֲרֵעֹתֶ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עֲשִׂיתֶֽם׃

passages.text: When the steward overtook them, he relayed these words to them.
passages.sermon:
Joseph had a steward.
The steward managed Joseph’s house.
The steward chased Joseph’s brothers.
The steward caught up with them.
The steward spoke to them.
The steward repeated Joseph’s words to them.
passages.original: וַֽיַּשִּׂגֵ֑ם וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵהֶ֔ם אֶת־ הַדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃

passages.text: “Why does my lord say these things?” they asked. “Your servants could not possibly do such a thing.
passages.sermon: Joseph’s brothers spoke to the steward.\r\nThey said, “Why does our master say these things?”\r\nThey said, “We, his servants, would never do such a thing.”
passages.original: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֔יו לָ֚מָּה יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֲדֹנִ֔י כַּדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה חָלִ֙ילָה֙ לַעֲבָדֶ֔יךָ מֵעֲשׂ֖וֹת כַּדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: We even brought back to you from the land of Canaan the silver we found in the mouths of our sacks. Why would we steal silver or gold from your master’s house?
passages.sermon:
The brothers of Joseph spoke to the steward.
They said, “We found silver in our sacks.”
“We brought that silver back to you from the land of Canaan.”
“We did not keep it.”
“Why would we steal silver from your master’s house?”
“Why would we steal gold from your master’s house?”
passages.original: הֵ֣ן כֶּ֗סֶף אֲשֶׁ֤ר מָצָ֙אנוּ֙ בְּפִ֣י אַמְתְּחֹתֵ֔ינוּ הֱשִׁיבֹ֥נוּ אֵלֶ֖יךָ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן וְאֵ֗יךְ נִגְנֹב֙ מִבֵּ֣ית אֲדֹנֶ֔יךָ כֶּ֖סֶף א֥וֹ זָהָֽב׃

passages.text: If any of your servants is found to have it, he must die, and the rest will become slaves of my lord.”
passages.sermon: The brothers of Joseph spoke to the steward in Egypt.\r\nThey said, “If any of your servants is found with the cup, he must die.”\r\nThey also said, “The rest of us will become slaves to my lord.”
passages.original: אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִמָּצֵ֥א אִתּ֛וֹ מֵעֲבָדֶ֖יךָ וָמֵ֑ת וְגַם־ אֲנַ֕חְנוּ נִֽהְיֶ֥ה לַֽאדֹנִ֖י לַעֲבָדִֽים׃

passages.text: “As you say,” replied the steward. “But only the one who is found with the cup will be my slave, and the rest of you shall be free of blame.”
passages.sermon:
The steward spoke to Joseph’s brothers.
He replied to their offer.
He said, “I accept your words.”
He said, “Only the one who is found with the cup will be my slave.”
He said, “The rest of you will be free from blame.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר גַּם־ עַתָּ֥ה כְדִבְרֵיכֶ֖ם כֶּן־ ה֑וּא אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִמָּצֵ֤א אִתּוֹ֙ יִהְיֶה־ לִּ֣י עָ֔בֶד וְאַתֶּ֖ם תִּהְי֥וּ נְקִיִּֽם׃

passages.text: So each one quickly lowered his sack to the ground and opened it.
passages.sermon:
Each man acted quickly.
Each man took his sack.
Each man lowered his sack to the ground.
Each man opened his sack.
passages.original: וַֽיְמַהֲר֗וּ וַיּוֹרִ֛דוּ אִ֥ישׁ אֶת־ אַמְתַּחְתּ֖וֹ אָ֑רְצָה וַֽיִּפְתְּח֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ אַמְתַּחְתּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: The steward searched, beginning with the oldest and ending with the youngest—and the cup was found in Benjamin’s sack.
passages.sermon:
The steward began to search the sacks.
He started with the oldest brother.
He finished with the youngest brother.
He found the cup in Benjamin’s sack.
passages.original: וַיְחַפֵּ֕שׂ בַּגָּד֣וֹל הֵחֵ֔ל וּבַקָּטֹ֖ן כִּלָּ֑ה וַיִּמָּצֵא֙ הַגָּבִ֔יעַ בְּאַמְתַּ֖חַת בִּנְיָמִֽן׃

passages.text: Then they all tore their clothes, loaded their donkeys, and returned to the city.
passages.sermon:
The brothers saw the cup in Benjamin’s sack.
They tore their clothes.
Each man loaded his donkey.
They returned to the city.
passages.original: וַֽיִּקְרְע֖וּ שִׂמְלֹתָ֑ם וַֽיַּעֲמֹס֙ אִ֣ישׁ עַל־ חֲמֹר֔וֹ וַיָּשֻׁ֖בוּ הָעִֽירָה׃

passages.text: When Judah and his brothers arrived at Joseph’s house, he was still there, and they fell to the ground before him.
passages.sermon:
Judah and his brothers went to Joseph’s house.
Joseph was still in the house.
Judah and his brothers saw Joseph.
They fell down to the ground in front of Joseph.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֨א יְהוּדָ֤ה וְאֶחָיו֙ בֵּ֣יתָה יוֹסֵ֔ף וְה֖וּא עוֹדֶ֣נּוּ שָׁ֑ם וַיִּפְּל֥וּ לְפָנָ֖יו אָֽרְצָה׃

passages.text: “What is this deed you have done?” Joseph declared. “Do you not know that a man like me can surely divine the truth?”
passages.sermon:
Joseph was the ruler of Egypt.
Joseph had great authority.
Joseph spoke to his brothers.
Joseph said, “What is this deed you have done?”
Joseph asked them about their actions.
Joseph said, “Do you not know this?”
Joseph said, “A man like me can surely discover the truth.”
Joseph said, “I have the power to find out secrets.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לָהֶם֙ יוֹסֵ֔ף מָֽה־ הַמַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה הַזֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲשִׂיתֶ֑ם הֲל֣וֹא יְדַעְתֶּ֔ם כִּֽי־ נַחֵ֧שׁ יְנַחֵ֛שׁ אִ֖ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר כָּמֹֽנִי׃

passages.text: “What can we say to my lord?” Judah replied. “How can we plead? How can we justify ourselves? God has exposed the iniquity of your servants. We are now my lord’s slaves—both we and the one who was found with the cup.”
passages.sermon:
Judah spoke to Joseph.
Judah and his brothers stood before Joseph.
Judah said, “What can we say to you, my lord?”
He said, “What can we speak?”
He said, “How can we prove ourselves innocent?”
Judah said, “God has found the guilt of your servants.”
Judah said, “We are now your slaves, my lord.”
He said, “We are your slaves, both we and the one who was found with the cup.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוּדָ֗ה מַה־ נֹּאמַר֙ לַֽאדֹנִ֔י מַה־ נְּדַבֵּ֖ר וּמַה־ נִּצְטַדָּ֑ק הָאֱלֹהִ֗ים מָצָא֙ אֶת־ עֲוֺ֣ן עֲבָדֶ֔יךָ הִנֶּנּ֤וּ עֲבָדִים֙ לַֽאדֹנִ֔י גַּם־ אֲנַ֕חְנוּ גַּ֛ם אֲשֶׁר־ נִמְצָ֥א הַגָּבִ֖יעַ בְּיָדֽוֹ׃

passages.text: But Joseph replied, “Far be it from me to do this. The man who was found with the cup will be my slave. The rest of you may return to your father in peace.”
passages.sermon:
Joseph was the ruler of Egypt.
Joseph spoke to his brothers.
Joseph said, "I will not do such a thing."
Joseph said, "The man who was found with the cup will be my slave."
Joseph said, "The rest of you may go back to your father in peace."
passages.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר חָלִ֣ילָה לִּ֔י מֵעֲשׂ֖וֹת זֹ֑את הָאִ֡ישׁ אֲשֶׁר֩ נִמְצָ֨א הַגָּבִ֜יעַ בְּיָד֗וֹ ה֚וּא יִהְיֶה־ לִּ֣י עָ֔בֶד וְאַתֶּ֕ם עֲל֥וּ לְשָׁל֖וֹם אֶל־ אֲבִיכֶֽם׃פ

passages.text: Then Judah approached Joseph and said, “Sir, please let your servant speak personally to my lord. Do not be angry with your servant, for you are equal to Pharaoh himself.
passages.sermon:
Judah was one of Joseph’s brothers.
Joseph was the ruler of Egypt.
Judah came close to Joseph.
Judah spoke to Joseph.
Judah said, “My lord, please let your servant speak to you.”
Judah asked Joseph not to be angry with him.
Judah said, “You are as important as Pharaoh.”
passages.original: וַיִּגַּ֨שׁ אֵלָ֜יו יְהוּדָ֗ה וַיֹּאמֶר֮ בִּ֣י אֲדֹנִי֒ יְדַבֶּר־ נָ֨א עַבְדְּךָ֤ דָבָר֙ בְּאָזְנֵ֣י אֲדֹנִ֔י וְאַל־ יִ֥חַר אַפְּךָ֖ בְּעַבְדֶּ֑ךָ כִּ֥י כָמ֖וֹךָ כְּפַרְעֹֽה׃

passages.text: My lord asked his servants, ‘Do you have a father or a brother?’
passages.sermon:
Joseph was the ruler in Egypt.
Joseph had great authority.
Joseph spoke to his brothers.
Joseph asked his brothers a question.
Joseph said, "Do you have a father?"
Joseph also said, "Do you have a brother?"
passages.original: אֲדֹנִ֣י שָׁאַ֔ל אֶת־ עֲבָדָ֖יו לֵאמֹ֑ר הֲיֵשׁ־ לָכֶ֥ם אָ֖ב אוֹ־ אָֽח׃

passages.text: And we answered, ‘We have an elderly father and a younger brother, the child of his old age. The boy’s brother is dead. He is the only one of his mother’s sons left, and his father loves him.’
passages.sermon:
Judah spoke to Joseph.
Judah answered Joseph’s question.
Judah said, “We have a father.
Our father is old.
We have a younger brother.
This brother was born when our father was old.
This younger brother had another brother.
That brother is dead.
Now only this younger brother remains from his mother.
Our father loves this younger brother.”
passages.original: וַנֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־ אֲדֹנִ֔י יֶשׁ־ לָ֙נוּ֙ אָ֣ב זָקֵ֔ן וְיֶ֥לֶד זְקֻנִ֖ים קָטָ֑ן וְאָחִ֨יו מֵ֜ת וַיִּוָּתֵ֨ר ה֧וּא לְבַדּ֛וֹ לְאִמּ֖וֹ וְאָבִ֥יו אֲהֵבֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Then you told your servants, ‘Bring him down to me so that I can see him for myself.’
passages.sermon: You spoke to your servants.\r\nYou said, “Bring the boy down to me.”\r\nYou said, “I will look after him myself.”
passages.original: וַתֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־ עֲבָדֶ֔יךָ הוֹרִדֻ֖הוּ אֵלָ֑י וְאָשִׂ֥ימָה עֵינִ֖י עָלָֽיו׃

passages.text: So we said to my lord, ‘The boy cannot leave his father. If he were to leave, his father would die.’
passages.sermon: We spoke to you, my lord.\r\nWe said, "The boy cannot leave his father."\r\nIf the boy leaves his father, his father will die.
passages.original: וַנֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־ אֲדֹנִ֔י לֹא־ יוּכַ֥ל הַנַּ֖עַר לַעֲזֹ֣ב אֶת־ אָבִ֑יו וְעָזַ֥ב אֶת־ אָבִ֖יו וָמֵֽת׃

passages.text: But you said to your servants, ‘Unless your younger brother comes down with you, you will not see my face again.’
passages.sermon: Joseph spoke to his brothers, who were his servants.\r\nJoseph said, "If your youngest brother does not come with you, you cannot see me again."\r\nJoseph made it clear that seeing him depended on bringing their youngest brother.
passages.original: וַתֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־ עֲבָדֶ֔יךָ אִם־ לֹ֥א יֵרֵ֛ד אֲחִיכֶ֥ם הַקָּטֹ֖ן אִתְּכֶ֑ם לֹ֥א תֹסִפ֖וּן לִרְא֥וֹת פָּנָֽי׃

passages.text: Now when we returned to your servant my father, we relayed your words to him.
passages.sermon:
We returned to our father.
Our father is your servant.
We told him your words.
We told him everything you said.
passages.original: וַיְהִי֙ כִּ֣י עָלִ֔ינוּ אֶֽל־ עַבְדְּךָ֖ אָבִ֑י וַנַּ֨גֶּד־ ל֔וֹ אֵ֖ת דִּבְרֵ֥י אֲדֹנִֽי׃

passages.text: Then our father said, ‘Go back and buy us some food.’
passages.sermon: Our father spoke to us.\r\nHe told us to return.\r\nHe told us to buy some food for us.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אָבִ֑ינוּ שֻׁ֖בוּ שִׁבְרוּ־ לָ֥נוּ מְעַט־ אֹֽכֶל׃

passages.text: But we answered, ‘We cannot go down there unless our younger brother goes with us. So if our younger brother is not with us, we cannot see the man.’
passages.sermon: We spoke to our father.\r\nWe said, “We cannot go down to Egypt unless our younger brother goes with us.\r\nIf our younger brother is not with us, we cannot see the man in Egypt.”
passages.original: וַנֹּ֕אמֶר לֹ֥א נוּכַ֖ל לָרֶ֑דֶת אִם־ יֵשׁ֩ אָחִ֨ינוּ הַקָּטֹ֤ן אִתָּ֙נוּ֙ וְיָרַ֔דְנוּ כִּי־ לֹ֣א נוּכַ֗ל לִרְאוֹת֙ פְּנֵ֣י הָאִ֔ישׁ וְאָחִ֥ינוּ הַקָּטֹ֖ן אֵינֶ֥נּוּ אִתָּֽנוּ׃

passages.text: And your servant my father said to us, ‘You know that my wife bore me two sons.
passages.sermon:
My father spoke to us.
My father is your servant.
He said, “You know this.”
My wife gave birth to two sons for me.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֛אמֶר עַבְדְּךָ֥ אָבִ֖י אֵלֵ֑ינוּ אַתֶּ֣ם יְדַעְתֶּ֔ם כִּ֥י שְׁנַ֖יִם יָֽלְדָה־ לִּ֥י אִשְׁתִּֽי׃

passages.text: When one of them was gone, I said: “Surely he has been torn to pieces.” And I have not seen him since.
passages.sermon:
Jacob is the father.
Jacob had two sons from his wife.
One son left Jacob.
Jacob said, "Surely a wild animal has torn him to pieces."
Jacob has not seen that son since then.
passages.original: וַיֵּצֵ֤א הָֽאֶחָד֙ מֵֽאִתִּ֔י וָאֹמַ֕ר אַ֖ךְ טָרֹ֣ף טֹרָ֑ף וְלֹ֥א רְאִיתִ֖יו עַד־ הֵֽנָּה׃

passages.text: Now if you also take this one from me and harm comes to him, you will bring my gray hair down to Sheol in sorrow.’
passages.sermon:
Jacob is the father.
Jacob is old.
Jacob has gray hair.
Jacob speaks to his sons.
Jacob says, "If you take this son from me,"
"And if harm comes to him,"
"You will cause me great sorrow."
"You will send me, an old man with gray hair, down to the grave in grief."
passages.original: וּלְקַחְתֶּ֧ם גַּם־ אֶת־ זֶ֛ה מֵעִ֥ם פָּנַ֖י וְקָרָ֣הוּ אָס֑וֹן וְהֽוֹרַדְתֶּ֧ם אֶת־ שֵׂיבָתִ֛י בְּרָעָ֖ה שְׁאֹֽלָה׃

passages.text: So if the boy is not with us when I return to your servant, and if my father, whose life is wrapped up in the boy’s life, sees that the boy is not with us, he will die. Then your servants will have brought the gray hair of your servant our father down to Sheol in sorrow.
passages.sermon:
Judah spoke to Joseph about his father Jacob and his youngest brother Benjamin.
Judah said, "My father is your servant.
My father loves the boy very much.
My father's life is closely tied to the boy's life.
If I return to my father and the boy is not with us, my father will see that the boy is missing.
When my father sees this, he will die from grief.
Your servants will cause our father, your servant, to go down to the grave in sorrow.
Our father's gray hair will go down to Sheol in sadness because of this loss."
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה כְּבֹאִי֙ אֶל־ עַבְדְּךָ֣ אָבִ֔י וְהַנַּ֖עַר אֵינֶ֣נּוּ אִתָּ֑נוּ וְנַפְשׁ֖וֹ קְשׁוּרָ֥ה בְנַפְשֽׁוֹ׃ וְהָיָ֗ה כִּרְאוֹת֛וֹ כִּי־ אֵ֥ין הַנַּ֖עַר וָמֵ֑ת וְהוֹרִ֨ידוּ עֲבָדֶ֜יךָ אֶת־ שֵׂיבַ֨ת עַבְדְּךָ֥ אָבִ֛ינוּ בְּיָג֖וֹן שְׁאֹֽלָה׃

passages.text: Indeed, your servant guaranteed the boy’s safety to my father, saying, ‘If I do not return him to you, I will bear the guilt before you, my father, all my life.’
passages.sermon:
Judah spoke to Joseph.
Judah called himself Joseph’s servant.
Judah promised his father Jacob that he would protect the boy Benjamin.
Judah said to his father, “I will bring Benjamin back to you.”
Judah said, “If I do not bring Benjamin back, I will be guilty before you, my father.”
Judah said, “I will carry this guilt all my life.”
passages.original: כִּ֤י עַבְדְּךָ֙ עָרַ֣ב אֶת־ הַנַּ֔עַר מֵעִ֥ם אָבִ֖י לֵאמֹ֑ר אִם־ לֹ֤א אֲבִיאֶ֙נּוּ֙ אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְחָטָ֥אתִי לְאָבִ֖י כָּל־ הַיָּמִֽים׃

passages.text: Now please let your servant stay here as my lord’s slave in place of the boy. Let him return with his brothers.
passages.sermon:
Judah spoke to Joseph.
Judah was one of Joseph’s brothers.
Judah said, “Please let me stay here as your slave.”
Judah wanted to take the place of the boy.
The boy was Benjamin.
Judah asked Joseph to let Benjamin go back with his brothers.
Judah wanted Benjamin to return home.
Judah wanted to remain instead of Benjamin.
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה יֵֽשֶׁב־ נָ֤א עַבְדְּךָ֙ תַּ֣חַת הַנַּ֔עַר עֶ֖בֶד לַֽאדֹנִ֑י וְהַנַּ֖עַר יַ֥עַל עִם־ אֶחָֽיו׃

passages.text: For how can I go back to my father without the boy? I could not bear to see the misery that would overwhelm him.”
passages.sermon:
Judah spoke to Joseph.
Judah was one of Joseph’s brothers.
Judah said, “I cannot return to my father if the boy is not with me.”
The boy was Benjamin, Judah’s youngest brother.
Judah said, “I cannot watch my father suffer.”
Judah knew his father would be overwhelmed with grief.
Judah did not want to see his father’s misery.
passages.original: כִּי־ אֵיךְ֙ אֶֽעֱלֶ֣ה אֶל־ אָבִ֔י וְהַנַּ֖עַר אֵינֶ֣נּוּ אִתִּ֑י פֶּ֚ן אֶרְאֶ֣ה בָרָ֔ע אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִמְצָ֖א אֶת־ אָבִֽי׃
